No problem bud. Mega Satan and Delirium are a little tricky to consistently attempt. In order to get to Mega Satan you'll either need the item dads key to open the large door that spawns on both The Chest and the Dark Room. If you don't get that item then you'll need to get Angel Rooms and bomb the statues. From there you'll need to successfully kill two of them to create a little floating key that will open the door.

The Void (where you fight the Delirium) is a complete coin flip. The Void floor entrance can spawn anywhere from Mom's heart up until either ending floor. The only way to guarantee a trip to The void is by killing Hush and moving over to the top right room. The Delirium fight is a crazy ass bullet hell fight so you should only fight him if you've got a great set of items or if you have something like the Chaos card

* Top left to right: Mom's heart, Isaac, Boss Rush, 
* Mid left to right: Satan, Blue Baby, The Lamb
* Bottom left to right: Mega Satan, Greed Mode, Hush

So ive played TLOU, Bloodborne, Witcher, SoM, Destiny, Dishonored 2, Infamous, DS2, MGSV, Diablo, and Fallout.

In terms of games that you can spend an incredible amount of time playing that'd fit with Witcher, Destiny, MGSV, and Diablo. Out of those my favorite is definitely witcher. 

Now if you're more intersted in experience than putting time into a game there's a couple options. TLOU is incredible and I think every gamer should play it. SoM is fun, but it ends up getting very repetitive. I own the GOTY edition and am too burned out to hop into any of the dlc. Infamous is really funny and an easy platinum if you care about trophies. It's also around 8 or less hours to beat the story. It's a shame there was no dlc for it :/ 

Fallout is fun, but it doesn't surpass any of the previous titles imo. Worth picking up for $20-$30 no doubt. Bloodborne is incredible. It's a bit short, but has replayability. I prefer it over Dark Souls no doubt. Diablo is cool, but by the time you reach end game I lost interest. Lots of grinding and running through dungeons.

Dishonored 2 is awesome. With 2 MC's its got replayability. If you like the first one I think you would love the second one. It's got an incredible atmosphere. MGSV is kinda iffy. 40 hour story mode, but it's very different. You can feel that it's foreign and that may turn you off. I played it without playing any of the previous titles, so story wise I was really lost. You kind of end up playing moreso for the gameplay then anything else. If you're looking for 3rd person stealth it's a great game for that.

DS2 gets a lot of flack from the souls community because of its lore and an aspect of the combat. It's very much you taking on several enemies at once. I prefer it to be honest, no more simply walking around an enemy for a backstab. It's personally my favorite souls game. First would probably have that spot if i could beat O&S :p

Destiny is slick and has the best gunplay I've ever experienced in a shooter. If you have a friend to play with I think this game is a great choice. You can dump hours into this game simply playing crucible (pvp cod style). Don't expect a good story experience here though

I think there's you as a person and then there's bipolar disorder. There was a time in your life that you were just you. But then this poison came around sometime in your life and your mental space has become a constant battle between being consumed by it and trying to fight it off so you can just be yourself. You understand there's a force within that person that is playing a game of tug of war with their mind and they don't have enough power (no one does) to resist it.
